html: ערשׂ (√ of foll.; cf. Arabic عَرْشٌ booth, shed, throne, عَرِيشٌ grape-trellis, woman’s (camel-) saddle; Ethiopic ዐሪሥ: booth (? also ዐራት: bed); Assyrian iršu, bed, couch; NH עֲרִיסָה cradle, 𝔗 עַרְסָא, Syriac ܥܰܪܣܳܐ, Palm. ערשא; the common idea is appar. that of a wooden structure, frame, cf. NöZMG xi (1886), 737).
